items.title_en: Doctors used live frogs as pregnancy tests in the 1950s and the results were actually reliable
items.title_zh: 20世纪50年代，医生使用活青蛙进行妊娠测试，结果确实可靠
items.summary_en: There was a very strange tradition back in history where people used frogs to correctly identify if a patient was pregnant – and it worked in the weirdest way. Science is amazing, and the way that the bodies of frogs work is equally as cool. The slimy little creatures are more than just household pets and fly catchers – they're nature's pregnancy detectors, too. According to Smithsonian Magazine , women conducted the ‘Hogben test’ before traditional pregnancy tests were created in the 1970s.
items.summary_zh: 历史上有一个非常奇怪的传统，人们用青蛙来正确识别病人是否怀孕——而且它以最奇怪的方式起作用。科学是令人惊奇的，青蛙身体的工作方式也同样很酷。这些粘糊糊的小生物不仅仅是家庭宠物和捕蝇器，它们还是大自然的怀孕探测器。据史密森尼杂志报道，女性在传统妊娠测试出现之前就进行了“霍格本测试”
